newsitem.title: USA: Schwab up on stock split, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Schwab up on stock split, earnings.

text.p: Shares of Charles Schwab Corp rose Thursday after the financial services company announced a three-for-two stock split and better than expected earnings on Wednesday, analysts said.
"The stock split and the fact that earnings came in a penny above consensus estimates are the overriding factors," said Sheldon Grodsky, analyst with Grodsky Associates Inc.
Grodsky, nevertheless, said he was a bit surprised by Wall Street's reaction since the company reported lower results year-over-year for the quarter.
Schwab reported second quarter earnings of $0.35 per share versus $0.39 per share a year earlier.
The consensus estimate, according to First Call, was for Schwab to report $0.34 a share for the second quarter.
